title: What was checked
summary: Each answer shows what the app checked, what a model only said, and what wasn't verified.
usage: An answer is marked not verified because no test, build or lint runs on it. Click What was checked under the answer to see the entry gate score, what the exit gate checked, the second opinion if any, and what wasn't verified. In Development mode the agent ends with what it ran, what it assumes and what it didn't verify.
